text:
alex-w: FYI saw latency tails spike on multi-tenant small-batch workloads on node gnode-5; looks correlated with NVMe offload hot-swap.

maria-s: Can you paste the perf sample? Are these bursty 1-4 token requests?

alex-w: Mostly 8-32 token responses, high QPS from a single tenant. Attached sample log:
```
2026-03-18T14:03:12Z INF tenant=acct-42 reqs=120/s avg_lat=18ms p95=140ms nvme_reads=830/s vram_evictions=1200/min
```

chen-l: Hmm nvme_reads that high suggests our prefetch window is starving vram. Are we hitting the async staging worker queue?

kyle-p: Could be pacing. We have a global offload rate limiter that kicks in under cross-tenant pressure; it stalls small-batches more than large ones.

alex-w: Right — I traced flow and saw the offload pump serializes writes when concurrency>64. That serialization + tiny batches amplifies latency.

maria-s: Proposed short-term: add tenant-weighted token bucket so a noisy neighbor can't consume the pump. Medium-term: per-tenant async write buffers with fast-path flush on small-batch hotpath.

chen-l: Architect question: do we expose tenant QoS tokens in the runtime API or keep strictly internal? Exposing allows product teams to self-serve but leaks implementation.

kyle-p: I prefer internal only. We should provide telemetry + auto-throttle suggestions in Console instead of API knobs.

alex-w: Implementation note: per-tenant buffers must be NUMA-aware on multi-socket nodes. Buffer placement on NVMe worker threads helps locality. Also need a backpressure signal so the scheduler avoids sending more KV cache writes.

maria-s: Draft config example for pacing limit suggestion:
```
offload:
  tenant_pacing:
    window_ms: "100"
    burst_tokens: "16"
    fair_share: "true"
```

alex-w: Also, eviction policy tweak: prefer demote-to-NVMe only when tenant buffer > X, otherwise keep in host staging for very small batches.

chen-l: We should run a canary with tenant_pacing.window_ms=50 and burst_tokens=8 on a Dedicated cluster; I can set it up.

infra-bot: canary-deploy started: canary/tier-2/pacing-test-20260318 on gnode-5 (build 2026.3.18-rc4) :rocket:

kyle-p: Great. Let's collect p95/p99 and nvme_reads. If regression is fixed we can move to autosuggest in Optimize.

alex-w: Thanks. I'll also add a tiny change to the offload pump to avoid full serialization when concurrency from same tenant < 8. Will push PR later today.

maria-s: Please add unit test for buffer placement and a lightweight perf test harness. :thumbsup:
